title: Uniqueness of algebraic normal form coefficients
statement: Let $c$ and $d$ be coefficient families indexed by subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. If their algebraic normal forms agree at every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, then $c=d$.
